# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Security fixes target the latest published release.

## Report A Vulnerability

Use [GitHub private vulnerability reporting][report].
You may also email [support@xquik.com](mailto:support@xquik.com).

Do not open a public issue.
Do not include secrets in screenshots, logs, or examples.

We aim to acknowledge reports within 3 business days.
We coordinate disclosure after confirming the issue.

## Scope

Security-sensitive areas include:

- API key and token handling
- Request construction and redirects
- Terminal output and local files
- Dependencies and generated code
- Release binaries, checksums, and provenance

## Safe Harbor

Act in good faith and avoid privacy violations.
Do not disrupt services or access unrelated data.
We will not pursue good-faith research following this policy.
